objective.statement: Debug the intermittent auth session drop that logs users out roughly once a day, apparently tied to token refresh.
objective.success_definition: Done when the trigger can be described and the fix holds for a week in production logs.

goals.statement: Identify and describe the trigger of the intermittent auth session drop.
acceptance: The trigger mechanism behind the roughly once-a-day logout is described.

goals.statement: Implement a fix for the session drop that holds for one week in production logs.
acceptance: One week of production logs after the fix shows no recurrence of the session drop.

constraints.statement: The AuthProvider interface must not be changed.

include: Authentication session handling, specifically the token refresh flow suspected of causing the drop

assumptions.statement: The investigation and fix are confined to the token refresh path within the auth/session module.

open_questions.question: Which files or components make up the token refresh flow, so the investigation scope can be bounded?

verification.spec: Review the written root-cause description identifying the trigger of the session drop.
verification.expected: A documented description of the trigger exists.

verification.spec: Review production auth/session logs for one week after deploying the fix.
verification.expected: No session-drop or unexpected logout events recur in production logs for one week.

deliverables.description: Description of the trigger causing the intermittent auth session drop.
Fix for the token-refresh-related session drop.

factors: Intermittent failure occurring roughly once a day is difficult to reproduce reliably
Success validation requires a week of production logs, delaying confirmation
